Name: Cute Halloween Costume for Jas 1.6 Compatible
Author: Suppabagga
Description:
Give's Jas a cute costume for Spirit's Eve! This mod is fully compatible with Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits, should also work with most other portrait mods, but incase it doesn't feel free to leave a comment, and I can most likely patch in compatibility!

If you're like me and think Jas's default smile looks goofy check out my other mod which is compatible with this one and another other vanlilla-esque portrait mod [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29245]Better Jas Smiles[/url][/u]!

Downloads.Description: Compatible with Poltergeister's Seasonal Outfits and Better Jas Smile!
